qualifications: Only two real eight-page saved captures masks0/7. Allhidden, all8profiles, duplicate observations, provided/captured lastmod, images/hreflang and malformed-profile response injection remain backend/VM scope.
Bounded independent Stored ZIP central/local directory, full CRC32 and strict simple XML reader; not a general ZIP/HTML5/XML conformance suite.
Raw report and relationship facts remain captured. Literal membership/diagnostic tables are independent of product selection/visibility helpers.
No pagination/token API exists for this producer; none is invented. Equality of XML does not imply equality of full ZIP identity.
Callbacks own actual App/Chrome/MCP/CLI/HTTP/files/downloads. This helper cannot release the native window or attest physical drain.

config.description: CrawlConfig: seed_urls or seed_url, sitemap_urls, concurrency, delay_ms, obey_robots, max_pages, optional renderer and sitemap_source_processing (max_post_http_entity_bytes, max_decoded_xml_bytes, max_xml_events), plus independent optional sitemap_membership_limits (max_catalog_json_bytes:1..134217728, max_row_json_bytes:1..1048576 and no greater than catalog cap, max_rows:1..1000000); absent membership limits preserve 32 MiB catalog/256 KiB row/1M rows, source work budgets do not widen page bodies or membership retention

cdn_classification.description: Optional version1 declared reporting classification for exact HTTP(S) origins. This does not grant fetch, HTML traversal, resource-origin or credential permission; no wildcard/subdomain inheritance or path scopes. None/null preserves legacy behavior.

cdn_directory_reporting.description: Optional own reporting profile: literal trailing-slash directories on ASCII DNS hosts, cross HTTP/HTTPS and one www alias, exact supported non-default port. Does not grant fetch, traversal, redirect, resource, header or credential permission; no vendor parity claim. Explicit80/443, IDNA, IPv6, wildcard and dot-segment declarations unsupported.

crawl_admission_limits.description: Opt-in version1 native PageDocument and redirect guards, before robots/rate/HTTP; renderer combination is refused. None/null preserves legacy behavior. At least one non-null bound is required. Folder depth counts all completed literal slash segments including empty segments, not encoded %2F. Raw query splits only on &: absent=0, present empty=1, duplicate keys/empty tokens count. Fetch bytes measure the normalized effective fetch alias, without rewriting original observations. No dynamic quotas.

crawl_quotas.description: Opt-in durable native target quotas. Zero is a real cap; null/absence disables a scalar. Ordered URL regex rules all charge matching buckets. Rust regex syntax; patterns are at most4096 UTF8 bytes each and32768 combined, compiled regex size is bounded by Core. Native resource discovery requires resource-contract-v2 in the existing internal host/explicit-port scope, include_subdomains=false, check_external=false and no external resource origins. Allowed fetched resources consume target capacity even when not retained as pages. No renderer or selected recrawl. Not vendor parity.

directive_reporting.description: Optional report-row hiding only. Crawling and outlink discovery remain unchanged. Canonical uses captured document identity; next/prev hides pages with observed prev only. project.json remains raw evidence.

sitemap_membership_limits.description: Independent explicit durable membership capacity; null/absence keeps legacy defaults. Row bytes cannot exceed catalog bytes; Rust validates this relation before crawl IO.

tools.description: Generate a deterministic segmented sitemap ZIP from a saved crawl. No website requests or artifact storage. Returns base64 once, actual SHA-256, filename and byte count. MCP ZIP limit 8 MiB; omitted total budget defaults to 8 MiB. Public base directory constrains origin/path. options.reporting_mode raw/reported or omitted/null Auto applies the saved active reporting profile before XML membership; full raw report SHA and raw lastmod/duplicate/relationship facts remain unchanged. Optional reporting metadata distinguishes captured/profile-visible/eligible/generated counts and equal-count mode identities. No preview/pagination token is introduced. Dates need explicit captured/provided sources; no freshness claim. UTF-8 byte bounds are enforced by the server in addition to these character bounds.

tools.name: spider_api_enrichment

tools.description: Apply ordered, overlapping field/regex segments to one stable saved crawl. Read pages/issues/counts/charts or export full JSON/CSV. Missing supported predicate facts stay unknown. Predicates support requested_url, final_url, status, media_type and stored_title only. Displayed depth may include legacy/import default0 and cannot be a predicate. No website requests or crawl permissions. CSV/JSON export requires the preview snapshot token. request.reporting_mode accepts raw or reported; omit/null applies an active saved reporting profile, otherwise legacy raw. Reported matching/counts/charts use visible page observations, preserve raw ordinals and bind profile/mode separately from raw snapshot identity.
tools.name: spider_segments

tools.description: Read the durable native crawl quota summary only. Legacy accounting stays unavailable; counts are never reconstructed from saved pages. No website requests, exports or profile mutation. Increase existing caps only through spider_resume with generation/profile revision/hash authority.
tools.name: spider_crawl_quotas

tools.description: Read saved N-gram totals, occurrences or source observations through the same local HTTP service; no website requests. request.reporting_mode accepts raw/reported; absent/null applies an active saved directive reporting profile, otherwise legacy raw. HTML/retained metadata channel fields and dense source ordinals retain their existing meaning; raw_page_ordinal separately identifies the original report observation. Multiple eligible duplicate URLs are refused. Preview is paged JSON; full filtered CSV requires its preview token and no continuation. Responses above128KiB require smaller pages or offline CLI CSV.
tools.name: spider_ngrams

tools.description: Inspect existing saved broken-source observations. Choose page_links for retained page links or resources for the verified resource ledger; these scopes are not interchangeable and neither claims whole-site coverage. Preview returns paged JSON. CSV requires the same preview token and no continuation, and returns complete base64 bytes plus verified HTTP length/SHA256. The resource CSV also verifies its snapshot header. Page-link JSON has no required server checksum attestation. No website requests, crawling, store paths or mutation. Request maximum4096 bytes, response maximum128KiB; use smaller pages or offline CLI CSV above that cap.
